name: For Great Honor
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Serving the Horde in one of the great battles against the Alliance is a source of great honor! The few however, that have served the Horde in ALL of our active battlefronts are our truly great fighters. We shall vanquish our opponents, not by fighting isolated skirmishes, but by waging a well-coordinated war.

Go forth and crush the Alliance in Arathi Basin, Alterac Valley, Eye of the Storm and Warsong Gulch! For Honor! For the Horde!
narrative.objectives: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor, 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor and 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
narrative.offerRewardText: Your trials have not been easy, but your courage did not escape you and your strength did not fail. Part with past tokens of victory, Champion. None shall need them as a reminder of your worth. Stand up straight, adventurer. Today you will walk with great pride for you are a hero!
narrative.requestItemsText: Arathi is still wet with the blood of great warriors and the clash of steel still rings throughout Alterac.  Do not waste my time unless you bring news from the front!
